need.doc: Consumable need-meter id this item satisfies (engine ships food/water/sleep as common ids; games register additional meter ids via engine.systems.needs.register_meter, e.g. a game's own hunger-adjacent resources).

locked.doc: If true, players cannot pick it up.

slot.doc: Combat equip slot (legacy armor/accessory normalize at load).

mods.doc: Combat modifiers: accuracy, crit_chance, crit_damage, block_chance, evasion, armor, initiative, stealth, damage.

materials.doc: Folklore bane tags: salt, iron, silver, wood, fire.

weapon_voice.doc: Combat prose voice family (firearm, bow, blade, …).

artifact_lexicon.doc: Unique artifact combat lexicon pool id.

true_artifact.doc: World-original mythic (First Blade, Mjolnir). Not Pit shade loot.

shade_artifact.doc: Pit-forged replica of a true_artifact row.

bound_owner_key.doc: Immersion/storage key of the rightful bearer (Thor, Odin, …).

worthy_wield.doc: If true, only the bound owner (or a stamped worthy flag) can equip it.

recall_bound.doc: Bound owner may call it to hand with recallrelic (Mjolnir-class).

elemental_damage.doc: Typed damage while this weapon is wielded (Mjolnir lightning).

never_miss.doc: Gungnir-class: miss, dodge, parry, and blink cannot fire. Block and crit still can.

cuts_warded.doc: Khadga-class: ignore gear/innate armor soak and Magic ward incoming soak.

breaks_wards.doc: Parashu-class: a landed hit shatters live wards and player-laid folklore barriers.

spawn_loaded_ammo.doc: Ammo catalog id to preload in the magazine at spawn.

ammo_kind.doc: Ammo stack kind id for reload/matching.

weight.doc: Carry weight in abstract units. Unset means the item does not count toward character burden (kit crumbs, clothing). Ore/ingot kinds require this; fish and other haul goods set it below ore.
